# Stellar Voice Agents

> Best-in-class AI voice agents that call, qualify and book leads 24/7, with the same AI following up by text, WhatsApp and website chat. Voice first, every channel covered. Built for businesses where slow follow-up loses revenue: Real Estate, Hotels, Solar, Healthcare, Finance, Trades and any team running ads or fielding inbound calls.

Stellar Voice Agents replaces slow, inconsistent, human-bottlenecked lead handling with AI agents that sound human, respond in seconds, and qualify and book around the clock. One agent, one prompt, one strategy, run across every channel: the agent that calls a lead is the same agent that texts them. Text vs WhatsApp is chosen automatically by the lead's country. The brand voice is direct, outcome-driven, no hype, no hedging.

## Products

- **Outbound Sales Qualifier**: The moment someone responds to an ad or fills a form, the AI calls them in seconds, qualifies on the call and books the meeting. If the call is not answered, the same AI follows up by text or WhatsApp until the lead is booked.
- **Dead Lead Reactivation**: The AI works aged-lead databases by call, text and WhatsApp, identifies who is ready to move now, and puts re-activated prospects back on the calendar. Case study: a 6% reactivation rate on 11-month-old leads produced a confirmed $500K property buyer.
- **Inbound Sales Qualifier**: Answers every inbound call instantly 24/7, qualifies each caller, books qualified prospects directly into the calendar. Case study: a 24/7 AI receptionist acting as a zero-miss safety net for a boutique agency's overflow and after-hours calls.
- **Appointment Engine**: The done-for-you funnel. Ads, AI calling and booking run as one managed system, priced around pilots.

Pricing is performance based: a low monthly retainer plus a fee per qualified booking. No public rate card; pricing is scoped per business on a demo call.

## Why teams choose Stellar

- Reliability is the product. Built on best-in-class AI (Google Gemini, OpenAI's ChatGPT models, ElevenLabs voices), orchestrated by an in-house platform.
- An in-house, state-of-the-art testing and simulation system puts every agent through hundreds of simulated conversations, edge cases and guardrail probes before it speaks to a real lead.
- Every conversation is recorded, transcribed and scored, and used to keep improving the agent over time.

## Industries served

Real Estate · Hotels & Hospitality · Solar · Healthcare · Finance · Trades & Home Services · Marketing Agencies · Any lead-driven business where speed-to-lead matters.

## Key signals & metrics

- Under 5 seconds from form fill to first call
- 17 to 25% booking rate on cold leads
- 24/7 coverage across voice, text, WhatsApp and chat
- 3x speed-to-lead vs human follow-up
- +45% additional leads captured outside business hours
